purpose: Scenario contract only. It identifies roles, legal setup actions and expected invariants. It is not authoritative gameplay state.

requirements: must qualify through canonical profession authority
must own/control one real completed personal home
operating-capital evidence must come from canonical Wallet projection
trade-knowledge evidence must come from an approved evidence authority; fixture may not fabricate qualification truth
must obtain a real item need through accepted runtime/fixture setup

referenceCase.physicalItemRule: the same exact physical item instance must move A -> B -> C; no clone/delete/remint

allowed: Create a deterministic world through existing world creation authority with at least three canonical agents.
Use existing canonical command/production paths to create the sale item.
Use existing canonical construction paths to produce B's completed personal home.
Use a validated canonical save as browser scenario preparation when needed, following existing Simclone browser-proof precedent.
Arrange non-claimed fixture conditions only when they do not substitute for the behavior being accepted.
forbiddenPrimaryEvidence: Directly push or splice the sale item into Rust possessions.
Directly change physical item ownership/location to simulate a trade.
Directly edit canonical wallet balances to simulate procurement or sale.
Directly create or edit Trade Kernel committed receipts.
Fabricate VERIFIED or COMMITTED transaction evidence.
Directly write Merchant Ledger Revenue, COGS or Realized Profit.
Directly teleport C or mutate C position to claim travel/arrival acceptance.
Directly write Home Market/listing/reservation state to claim production runtime acceptance.
Use hidden compatibility aliases or adapters that convert a noncanonical listingId-only shape into canonical listing.id/revision for the purpose of passing acceptance.
Directly push/splice HomeMarket listingIds or buyOfferIds from integration/test code instead of using the canonical Home Market writer.
Invent or hardcode tradeRange in integration/test code without a named canonical source.
Construct verified arrival/position evidence outside the approved Navigation evidence producer.
Create a Reservation in fixture/test code when the production Reservation authority/lifecycle is absent.
Fabricate a complete Navigation arrival evidence object and recompute its deterministic evidenceId instead of resolving canonical Navigation journey/execution provenance.
Forge a matching Trade receipt + tradeReplay graph + recomputed hashes and promote it to committed Ledger/Career evidence.

browser.primaryInteraction: real clicks/taps -> command intent -> runtime -> canonical validation -> authoritative mutation -> visible result
browser.note: A validated save may prepare prerequisites, but every RC4 trade mutation claimed by browser acceptance must be produced by real UI/command/runtime flow.

producer: canonical Rust item snapshot with item id and createdBy=A
homeMarket: before/after housing capacity and building state
canonical Home Market reference-writer evidence for listingIds/buyOfferIds
trade: canonical wallet snapshots and total currency
canonical Rust ownership/provenance before and after
documented market projection provenance for id/open/x/y/tradeRange

immutableFailureSnapshot.comparison: byte-identical canonical serialization before vs after every failed atomic attack
immutableFailureSnapshot.exception: No exception permits partial mutation or compensating rollback to count as SAT.

persistence.replayAfterReload: old committed transaction must be a full authoritative no-op

migration.source: pre-RC4 save with no RC4 components
required: no silent money creation except explicitly approved canonical wallet bootstrap

masterGate.rule: All Phase-0 readiness rows must be SAT before Phase-1 integrated evidence can count.
